name: Corn Incremental! [UPD 14]
desc:
Welcome to Corn Incremental!

🌽 Plant and grow corn to build your farming empire from scratch.
⚙️ Buy Upgrades, and expand your farm!
💰 Level up and unlock new currencies
🔥 Automate and scale up to become the ultimate corn farmer!

Inspired by: Circle Incremental, Everything Upgrade Tree, Money Clicker Inc

Update 14

**NEW CORN COLLECTING ANIMATIONS & UI REVAMP**
- Collecting corn just got a massive upgrade! Enjoy fresh animations and a cleaner UI every time you harvest your crops.

**BUG FIXES**
- Fixed gamepass wall not prompting
- Optimized collecting and new circle collect style.
